defect: The inaccessible-formatter diagnostic is reported only for formatters excluded from the source-generated resolver (the negation was dropped), instead of for those included in it.
why: A formatter the generated resolver includes but cannot access is the case the diagnostic exists for; excluded formatters are never referenced by the resolver, so reporting them is noise and the real cases go unreported.
